qualification.scope: Local production input and call-boundary paths; no native Windows or live Excel timing
qualification.allocation_counters: Allocator request counts and cumulative requested bytes, not RSS or peak live bytes
qualification.statistic: Geometric mean of two independent Criterion estimates per variant. Per-run confidence intervals do not form a confidence interval for the A/B difference.
qualification.hash_validation: Every frozen executable hash checked before and after each invocation; final measured source hashes checked before archiving. Shared harness byte-identical on both sides.

adoption.scope: First nonempty borrowed string per call, at most 23 UTF-8 bytes, outside large typed collections. Empty strings return a static empty slice. Public owned String conversion is unchanged.
adoption.tradeoffs: Scalar f64 ingress +1.2%; eight scalar arguments with one worker +1.4%. Other tested long/bulk/concurrent controls range from -1.3% to +0.7%; these small differences are not claimed as statistically significant.
adoption.initial_candidate: Rejected initial empty-string handling (+52.5%); final candidate bypasses storage for empty strings.

additional_small_collection_control.interpretation: The three-cell mixed borrowed fixture measured -3.1%, with overlapping per-run confidence intervals. The 100-cell mixed controls had wide baseline intervals and much larger changes; these are retained but not attributed to a general matrix speed improvement.

reproduction.baseline: git archive baseline_head into an independent checkout; apply baseline_harness_patch
reproduction.candidate: same baseline revision plus baseline_harness_patch and candidate_production_patch
reproduction.build: cargo bench -p xlfn --features bench-internals,async --bench argument_ingress --bench sync_boundary --bench value_boundary_allocations --no-run --locked; use separate CARGO_TARGET_DIR per side
reproduction.run: Freeze executables and verify SHA-256 before/after every invocation. ABBA, recorded filters, --bench --sample-size 20 --warm-up-time 0.5 --noplot; XLFN_BENCH_MEASUREMENT_MS=2000 and per-round CARGO_TARGET_DIR. Run allocation probe separately.
reproduction.shared_fixture_check: Shared measured harness sources were byte-identical before the isolated comparison. Afterwards the allocation probe gained zero-allocation assertions; fixtures and measured calls stayed unchanged.
